scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB_ENC_KEY.description: Encrypts sensitive columns in D1. 32 random bytes, base64. Generate both secrets at once with `node -e "const c=require('crypto'),t=c.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');console.log('admin token:',t);console.log('ADMIN_TOKEN_HASH:',c.createHash('sha256').update(t).digest('hex'));console.log('DB_ENC_KEY:',c.randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))"`. Keep a copy: if it is lost, the encrypted columns cannot be read.

ADMIN_TOKEN_HASH.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the token you will use to sign in to the dashboard. Use the value printed by the same command, and store the **admin token** itself in your password manager.
